list: SELECT j.id, e.name FROM jobs AS j LEFT JOIN employers AS e ON j.district=e.district AND j.code=e.code WHERE j.district=:area ORDER BY j.id
phone_directory: SELECT j.id, e.name FROM jobs AS j LEFT JOIN employers AS e ON j.district=e.district AND j.code=e.code WHERE j.district=:area ORDER BY e.private_phone
